$comment: Text pool for the Finances/Job prayer category.
requests: Job interview Thursday morning. Pray for calm nerves and clear thinking.
Laid off this week. Trusting God, but scared.
For wisdom with our budget this month. It is tight.
My husband is looking for work. Pray for the right door to open.
Rent is due Friday and we are short. Pray for provision.
I lost my job at the plant last month after 14 years. I am 56 and not sure who will hire me. Pray for a new job and for me to not lose hope.
My son just finished his degree and has applied to more than 40 places with no offers. He is discouraged. Pray for a breakthrough and for him to keep going.
There are rumors of layoffs at my company and everyone is on edge. Pray for peace at work and for wisdom for the leaders making the decisions.
We have a stack of medical bills from my wife's surgery last spring. We are making payments, but it feels like we will never get out. Pray for provision and peace.
Our small landscaping business had a slow summer, and we are behind on bills. Pray for more customers this fall and wisdom for how to keep going.
My boss is very hard to work for. He criticizes everything and I dread going in. Pray for me to keep a good attitude and for things to change, or for a new job.
Asking for prayer as I think about a career change. I have been in sales for 20 years and feel called to teaching. Pray for clear direction and courage.
My friend from small group was let go from his job on Monday. He has three kids and a mortgage. Pray for a quick new job and peace for his family.
We are a single-income family and just barely making ends meet. Pray for wisdom with every dollar and for unexpected provision.
God has always provided for us, and I am trusting Him again. My hours were cut in half last week. Pray for more work and for faith that does not waver.
Second interview tomorrow for a job I really want. It would mean more stability for our family. Pray for favor, and for peace if the answer is no.
My daughter is a single mom working two jobs to cover rent in Tempe. She is exhausted. Pray for a better-paying job with hours that let her be home more.
Lord, give me wisdom with our money. I have made some poor choices with credit cards and I am ashamed. Help me get out of this and stay out.
My coworker's position is being eliminated at the end of the month. She is the main earner in her home. Pray for her next job to come quickly.
We have been looking for a cheaper place to rent for months with no luck. Our lease ends soon. Pray for the right place at a price we can manage.
Starting my own bakery out of our home kitchen. It is a big step of faith. Pray for steady orders and for me to run it well and honestly.
My husband has been out of work since spring. He is doing everything right, but nothing is landing. Pray for his spirit, which is getting low.
Would you pray about my work situation? There is a lot of conflict on my team and I am caught in the middle. Pray for peace and for my words to be kind.
Our car broke down and the repair costs more than we have. I need it to get to work. Pray for a solution, whether that is the money or another way.
For my brother, who just took a new job in sales after years of construction. It is a big change. Pray he learns quickly and finds favor with his new boss.

I was laid off six months ago, and I have learned more about trusting God in that time than in the ten years before it. Our savings are almost gone now, though, and the pressure is real. I have had a few interviews but nothing has come through. Pray for a job that fits my skills and supports my family, and for me to lead my home with faith and not fear while we wait.

My wife and I own a small auto repair shop in Glendale. We have been open eight years, but this has been our hardest year yet. Costs keep going up, and a few big customers have moved on. We have six employees who depend on us. Pray for wisdom on hard choices, for new business, and for us to treat our people well no matter what happens.

This is a hard one to share. We are behind on rent for the second month, and my hours at work have not come back since they were cut. We have talked with the landlord and he is giving us a little time. I am grateful for that. Pray for steady work, for wisdom in what to cut, and for our kids not to feel the stress we are carrying.

My manager has made work really hard for me this year. She takes credit for my work and speaks down to me in front of others. I have tried to talk with her and it did not help. I do not want to become bitter. Pray for wisdom on whether to stay or look for something new, and for me to keep doing good work as if working for the Lord.

My dad is 62 and was just told his job is ending after 30 years at the same company. He was planning to retire in a few years, and now he is not sure what to do. He is proud and does not like to ask for help. Pray for wisdom about his next step, for peace about money, and for him to know his worth is not his job.
details: We know God sees our needs, and we are choosing to trust Him one day at a time.
The stress has been hard on our whole household. Pray for peace at home too.
We are doing what we can on our end. The rest is in God's hands.
I am trying not to let worry steal my sleep, but it has been hard lately.
We have cut back where we can and are grateful for what we do have.
Pray for wisdom with every decision, big and small, in the weeks ahead.
Pray for humility to accept help if it comes, and gratitude no matter what.
It is easy to feel like a failure in seasons like this. Pray against that lie.
"My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus" (Philippians 4:19, WEB).
Our church family has already been so kind. Thank you for carrying this with us.
We would love prayer for contentment, whatever the outcome turns out to be.
Some days I feel strong in faith, and some days I just feel tired.
answers: God provided! Thank you for praying with us.
Things are more stable now. Thank you for standing with us.
Not fully settled yet, but there has been real progress. Keep praying.
Still waiting, but at peace. God has met every need so far.
A door opened that we did not see coming. We are so grateful.
We are in a better place than we were. Thank you, church family.
Things are not where we hoped yet, but we have enough for today. That is a gift.
Praise report: the pressure has eased a lot this month.
God answered in a way I did not expect, and it is better than what I asked for.
We are still in the middle of this. Your prayers have kept us going.
Some good news to share. Things are finally moving in the right direction.
Answered! Thank you all for praying and checking in.
